methodology: To systematically decompose the provided information into atomic units, I identified individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints, ensuring each unit was independent, specific, and implementable as a single requirement.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a gshare branch predictor with a 7-bit PC and global history.
Hash PC and global history using XOR to generate a 7-bit index.
Access a 128-entry table of two-bit saturating counters using the index.
Include interfaces for prediction and training.
Update the global branch history register based on branch outcomes.
Handle simultaneous prediction and training requests with precedence rules.
Initialize the global branch history register to zero.
spec_atomic_units: Define a gshare branch predictor module with specified inputs and outputs.
Use XOR to compute a 7-bit index from PC and global history.
Access a 128-entry PHT with two-bit saturating counters using the index.
Provide prediction and training interfaces with detailed behaviors.
Update the PHT based on actual branch outcomes during training.
Prioritize training over prediction in simultaneous operations.
Implement asynchronous active-high reset for initialization.
Ensure proper timing and synchronization for all updates.
